projects.title: ADVANCED WARFARE
projects.subtitle: Call of Duty Series
projects.description: Future-warfare first-person shooter featuring advanced exoskeleton mechanics, vertical movement, and high-tech weaponry. One of the most innovative entries in the franchise.
